name: TLD GPU
description: Mobile ground power unit supplying electrical power to parked aircraft.

tasks.name: Engine Oil & Filter Change
tasks.description: Drain the engine oil and replace the oil filter. Sample data: verify against the OEM manual.

steps.title: Prepare and isolate
steps.text: Park on level ground, apply the parking brake, shut down the engine and remove the key. Let the engine cool. Disconnect the battery negative terminal.
steps.warning: Make sure no output cable is connected to an aircraft.

steps.title: Drain the oil
steps.text: Place the drain pan under the sump. Remove the drain plug and let the oil drain completely.
steps.warning: Oil may still be hot. Wear gloves.

steps.title: Remove the old filter
steps.text: Unscrew the old oil filter with the filter wrench. Wipe the filter mounting face clean.

steps.title: Fit the new filter
steps.text: Lightly oil the new filter gasket. Screw on by hand until the gasket touches, then tighten as printed on the filter.

steps.title: Refit the drain plug
steps.text: Fit a new sealing washer. Tighten the drain plug to the torque in the manual.

steps.title: Refill with oil
steps.text: Add new oil through the filler with the funnel. Check the dipstick and stop at the FULL mark.

steps.title: Run and check for leaks
steps.text: Reconnect the battery and start the engine for 2 minutes. Look for leaks, shut down, recheck the level and record the job in the log.

tasks.name: Periodic Inspection
tasks.description: General condition check of the ground power unit and output cables.

steps.title: Walk-around inspection
steps.text: Check the body, doors, tyres, tow bar and lights for damage or leaks.

steps.title: Check fluids
steps.text: Check engine oil, coolant and fuel levels. Top up if needed.

steps.title: Inspect output cables
steps.text: Check cable insulation and connector pins for cuts, burns or corrosion. Tighten loose covers.
steps.warning: Never inspect cables while the unit is running.

steps.title: Check battery and voltage
steps.text: Check the battery terminals. Measure the battery voltage and the output voltage at idle.

steps.title: Function test and log
steps.text: Run a no-load test, confirm normal readings and record the inspection.

name: HYD RIG AHT 95M
description: Mobile hydraulic rig used to service and test aircraft hydraulic systems.

tasks.name: Hydraulic Filter Element Replacement
tasks.description: Replace the pressure filter element and seals. Sample data: verify against the OEM manual.

steps.title: Shut down and depressurise
steps.text: Stop the pump, release the system pressure and confirm the gauge reads zero.
steps.warning: Hydraulic fluid under pressure can penetrate skin. Wear glasses and gloves.

steps.title: Drain the filter bowl
steps.text: Place the container under the filter housing. Open the drain and let the fluid drain.

steps.title: Remove the old element
steps.text: Unscrew the bowl and remove the element. Check the element for metal particles and note anything unusual.

steps.title: Clean the housing
steps.text: Wipe the bowl and housing with a clean cloth. Do not use fluffy rags.

steps.title: Install the new element
steps.text: Lubricate the new O-rings with clean hydraulic fluid and fit the new element.

steps.title: Refit the bowl
steps.text: Screw the bowl back on and tighten to the specified torque.

steps.title: Fill, bleed and leak test
steps.text: Top up the reservoir, run the pump at low pressure, bleed air, then check for leaks at full pressure. Record the job.

name: AIR COMPRESSOR (PORTABLE)
description: Portable air compressor for tyre inflation and workshop air supply on the apron.

tasks.name: Intake Air Filter Replacement
tasks.description: Replace the compressor intake air filter. Sample data: verify against the OEM manual.

steps.title: Shut down and make safe
steps.text: Stop the compressor, release the air pressure and disconnect the battery or power.
steps.warning: Do not open the filter housing while the unit is pressurised.

steps.title: Open the filter housing
steps.text: Release the clips or screws and remove the housing cover.

steps.title: Remove the old filter
steps.text: Take out the old filter and check it for oil or damage.

steps.title: Clean the housing
steps.text: Brush and wipe the housing and seat. Keep dirt out of the intake.

steps.title: Fit the new filter and close
steps.text: Fit the new filter, refit the cover and tighten. Start the unit, check for air leaks and record the job.
